headline: H100 SXM and H200 indexes fell over 7 days while MI300X leads price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index fell -19% over 7 days to $4.32, with Vast.ai cheapest at $2.46 and hyperscalers at $10.68, a +162% premium over neoclouds.
H200's index dropped -14% to $5.40, and RunPod Community Cloud's $3.59 median undercuts the $10.30 hyperscaler median.
B200 held flat at +0% with an index of $8.50, and hyperscalers charge $14.12 versus $7.99 at neoclouds, a +77% premium.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, though only 5 providers list it and its marketplace median sits at $0.50.
A100 80GB SXM ($2.70) and L40S ($1.50) were unchanged at +0%, with Vast.ai cheapest on both at $1.08 and $0.67.
watch: Watch whether H100 SXM's -19% and H200's -14% weekly declines continue or stabilize at the next 7-day read.
